intro: Treshala's Pendant is an intimate heirloom of bonding belonging to Treshala Fallowbrook, a night elf dwelling in Darnassus. Carried into southern Kalimdor by her husband, Heralath, it was ripped away by the quilboar in Razorfen Kraul as he lay dying.

p: The pendant serves as a symbol of deep marital devotion between Treshala and Heralath Fallowbrook. Before embarking on perilous journeys away from Teldrassil, Heralath carried the bonding necklace close as a reminder of his home and his beloved.
